name: Write YouTube video and channel descriptions
description: Users asked to write video and channel descriptions, bios, and supplementary metadata such as tags and captions for YouTube content. The requests covered a wide range of topics, including art tutorials, news, nature, and relationship psychology, with specific focus on improving SEO, discoverability, and search engine ranking.
